message.content: {"note_claim": "Under UNCLOS Article 110(1)(d), warships may board vessels suspected of being stateless on the high seas.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "a warship which encounters on the high seas a foreign ship, other than a ship entitled to complete immunity in accordance with articles 95 and 96, is not justified in boarding it unless there is reasonable ground for suspecting that: ... (d) the ship is without nationality", "reason": "Article 110(1)(d) of UNCLOS Part VII, as reproduced on the page, authorizes warships to board ships reasonably suspected of being without nationality, substantiating the note's legal claim (though not the specifics about the Tagor's flag or the event itself)."}

parsed.note_claim: Under UNCLOS Article 110(1)(d), warships may board vessels suspected of being stateless on the high seas.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: a warship which encounters on the high seas a foreign ship, other than a ship entitled to complete immunity in accordance with articles 95 and 96, is not justified in boarding it unless there is reasonable ground for suspecting that: ... (d) the ship is without nationality
parsed.reason: Article 110(1)(d) of UNCLOS Part VII, as reproduced on the page, authorizes warships to board ships reasonably suspected of being without nationality, substantiating the note's legal claim (though not the specifics about the Tagor's flag or the event itself).
